newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-HUSSAIN AND CRAWLEY HOLD UP AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HUSSAIN AND CRAWLEY HOLD UP AUSTRALIA.

text.p: An unfinished century stand between Nasser Hussain and John Crawley held up Australia's push for victory in the fourth Ashes test at Headingley on Sunday.
England, 329 behind on first innings, slipped to 89 for four before Hussain (101 not out) and Crawley (48) lifted their side to 212 for four at the close on the fourth day.
Their unbeaten fifth-wicket stand of 123 left England still 117 behind with one day remaining.
Pace trio Glenn McGrath, who took two wickets, and Paul Reiffel and Jason Gillespie, with one each, sent England sliding between lunch and tea.
Australia had extended their overnight 373 for five to 501 for nine declared at lunch,, with opener Matthew Elliott making an outstanding 199.
The two teams are level 1-1 in the six-test series.
